derivation: from H5794 (עַז) and the root of H950 (בּוּקָה); stern depopulator;

occurrences.text: After him repaired Nehemiah the son of Azbuk, the ruler of the half part of Beth–zur, unto the place over against the sepulchres of David, and to the pool that was made, and unto the house of the mighty.
